Gera documentação técnica consolidada para sistemas de software com múltiplos repositórios (frontend, backend, microservices, wikis). Use quando o usuário pedir documentação de multi-repo, visão de arquitetura consolidada, mapeamento de re.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: generate consolidated technical documentation for multi-repository systems.

- Detects and clusters local git repositories (including wikis) into logical systems.
- Analyzes each repository to extract language, structure, API routes, manifests, and key documentation.
- Generates comprehensive documentation: overviews, architecture, deployment, repo maps, and process guidelines per system and repository.
- Outputs structured documentation folders without modifying source repositories.
- Supports Java, Python, JavaScript; recognizes backend, frontend, microservices, infra, docs, and wikis.
